versions.changelog: Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

- Documentation updates: made minor edits to SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md.
- No changes to logic or functionality.

- Added instructions for the new authentication method using the `dlazy login` device-code flow, making setup easier.
- Updated manual API key setting as an alternative, instead of primary method.
- Clarified authentication section and reorganized guidance for obtaining and saving the API key.
- No changes to functionality or CLI options.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Minor documentation updates in SKILL.md and language variants.
- Clarified agent instructions on handling missing or unauthorized API keys.
- Improved guidance for users on API key provisioning and usage steps.
- No functional changes to how SVG generation works.

- Added detailed authentication instructions, including API key setup and retrieval steps.
- Updated global CLI installation command to use @dlazy/cli@1.0.6.
- Clarified that all requests require API key configuration via the CLI.

- Initial release of dlazy-recraft-v3-svg.
- Generate high-quality SVG vector graphics from text using Recraft v3.
- Supports prompt customization, aspect ratio, and style options.
- Provides error handling for common issues such as missing API key and insufficient balance.
- Includes command examples and agent instructions for handling user authentication and balance errors.
